hero.headline: CIPS Level 2 Certificate in Procurement and Supply Operations
hero.sub_headline: Take your first step into procurement and supply, no prior experience needed. Build the foundational knowledge that starts your journey toward MCIPS.
key_facts: Entry Level - no formal entry requirements
Up to 12 months typical study duration

course_overview.headline: About This Qualification
course_overview.body:
The CIPS Level 2 Certificate in Procurement and Supply Operations is the first qualification on the CIPS pathway; designed for anyone new to the profession. There's no prior procurement knowledge or business experience required, making it the natural starting point for school leavers, administrative staff, or anyone considering a career change into procurement and supply.

You'll build a clear understanding of core procurement processes, terminology and best practice, setting you up to progress confidently to Level 3 and beyond.

who_its_for.headline: Is Level 2 Right for You?
who_its_for.body: Level 2 is designed for anyone starting out in procurement with little or no prior business experience - including school leavers, those in an administrative or support role, and career changers exploring procurement for the first time.
who_its_for.entry_requirements: No formal entry requirements. This qualification is open to anyone ready to begin their procurement career.

modules.headline: Course Modules
modules.sub_text: Complete all five core modules to achieve the full Certificate.

core_modules.name: Introducing Procurement and Supply
core_modules.description: Understand the role of procurement and supply in organisations, the "Five Rights" of procurement, the stages of the sourcing process, and the ethical responsibilities involved.

core_modules.name: Procurement and Supply Operations
core_modules.description: Understand different types of organisations, how they operate, contractual agreements, sources of supplier information, and basic pricing techniques.

core_modules.name: Stakeholder Relationships
core_modules.description: Identify internal and external stakeholders in procurement and supply, key market factors, effective communication techniques, and approaches to conflict resolution.

core_modules.name: Systems Technology
core_modules.description: Understand the systems and technology used to support procurement and supply operations, including e-procurement and data handling basics.

core_modules.name: Inventory, Logistics and Expediting
core_modules.description: Understand inventory management, logistics processes, and the techniques used to expedite orders and manage supply flow.

faq.answer: No - Level 2 has no formal entry requirements and is designed for anyone new to procurement and supply.

hero.headline: CIPS Level 3 Advanced Certificate in Procurement and Supply Operations
hero.sub_headline: Sharpen your operational skills and start choosing your specialism; the next step for anyone building a career in procurement and supply.
key_facts: Entry Level - no formal entry requirements
Up to 12 months typical study duration

course_overview.headline: About This Qualification
course_overview.body:
The CIPS Level 3 Advanced Certificate in Procurement and Supply Operations builds on the fundamentals covered at Level 2, developing the operational skills needed to carry out procurement and supply tasks effectively. It's also the first level where you get to specialise - choosing an elective module that suits your interests, whether that's socially responsible procurement or warehousing and distribution.

Level 3 is one of the first steps on the pathway to MCIPS Chartered status, bridging the gap between operational tasks and the strategic capability you'll build from Level 4 onward.

It also suits Level 2 graduates ready for the next step.
who_its_for.entry_requirements: No formal entry requirements. Completing Level 2 first is recommended but not required.

hero.headline: CIPS Level 4 Diploma in Procurement and Supply
hero.sub_headline: Move from operational buying into strategic sourcing, commercial contracting and negotiation; the qualification most professionals choose to begin their journey toward MCIPS.
key_facts: Ofqual Regulated - equivalent to first-year undergraduate level

course_overview.headline: About This Qualification
course_overview.body:
The CIPS Level 4 Diploma in Procurement and Supply is the highest level you can start at directly, without completing Levels 2 or 3 first, provided you meet the entry requirements below. It's built for professionals ready to move beyond day-to-day operational buying into strategic sourcing, contract management and supplier relationships.

This is the first of the three qualifications (Levels 4, 5 and 6) that make up the direct pathway to MCIPS Chartered status.

left_side.counter_text: Use the counter for 7 days, which will be rotated every week
left_side.contact_text: We’ll contact you to discuss your enquiry, help you choose the right course, and let you know of any special offers.

who_its_for.headline: Is Level 4 Right for You?
who_its_for.body: Level 4 is designed for professionals who already have some grounding in a business environment and are ready to build a comprehensive procurement toolkit. It suits people working toward or already in roles such as Buyer, Contract Officer, or Procurement Executive.
who_its_for.entry_requirements: A minimum of two A-Levels (or an equivalent international qualification), or a CIPS Level 3 Advanced Certificate, or a minimum of two years' relevant commercial experience.

modules.headline: Course Modules
modules.sub_text: Complete all eight core modules to achieve the full Diploma.

core_modules.name: Scope and Influence of Procurement and Supply
core_modules.description: Understand how procurement adds value to an organisation, the key steps in procuring goods and services, and the compliance considerations that shape procurement activity.

core_modules.name: Defining Business Need
core_modules.description: Learn to build a business case for external sourcing, and understand market management and specification-writing in procurement and supply.

core_modules.name: Commercial Contracting
core_modules.description: Understand the legal foundations of contract formation, key contract clauses, and the options available when sourcing from suppliers.

core_modules.name: Ethical and Responsible Sourcing
core_modules.description: Explore ethical and sustainable sourcing practice, and how responsible procurement supports long-term organisational value.

core_modules.name: Commercial Negotiation
core_modules.description: Build practical negotiation skills for commercial procurement scenarios, from preparation through to closing agreements.

core_modules.name: Supplier Relationships
core_modules.description: Understand relationship dynamics across the supply chain, and when and how to build effective supplier partnerships.

core_modules.name: Whole Life Asset Management
core_modules.description: Learn to manage inventory, storage and movement, and apply whole-life costing principles to procurement decisions.

core_modules.name: Procurement and Supply in Practice
core_modules.description: Apply the procurement cycle, sourcing process, whole life asset management, and ethical sourcing principles in a practical, applied assessment.

hero.headline: CIPS Level 5 Advanced Diploma in Procurement and Supply
hero.sub_headline: Step into senior-level capability, managing risk, contracts and teams, and specialising in the areas that matter most to your career.
key_facts: Ofqual Regulated - equivalent to second-year undergraduate level

course_overview.headline: About This Qualification
course_overview.body:
The CIPS Level 5 Advanced Diploma in Procurement and Supply builds directly on the Level 4 Diploma, developing higher-level practical, theoretical and technical expertise. You'll take a whole-organisation, whole-supply-chain view learning to manage risk in supply chains, assess the legal implications of contracts, and lead teams through change.

Level 5 is the second of the three qualifications (Levels 4, 5 and 6) that make up the direct pathway to MCIPS Chartered status, and it's where you begin to specialise in the areas most relevant to your career direction.

who_its_for.headline: Is Level 5 Right for You?
who_its_for.body: Level 5 is designed for experienced procurement professionals, senior buyers and managers ready to move into strategic management and leadership roles, including Category Manager, Procurement Manager, or Supply Chain Lead positions.
who_its_for.entry_requirements: Completion of the CIPS Level 4 Diploma (or an accepted exemption). This is not an entry-level qualification.

core_modules.name: Managing Contractual Risk

core_modules.name: Advanced Contract and Financial Management
core_modules.description: Assess strategic sourcing and the financial factors that impact procurement and supply activity, from cost analysis to investment appraisal.

core_modules.name: Managing Ethical Procurement and Supply
core_modules.description: Build your capability to embed ethical practice across complex procurement and supply environments.

elective_modules.name: Category Management
elective_modules.description: Develop a category management approach to procurement, aligning strategy with organisational priorities.

elective_modules.name: Achieving Competitive Advantage Through the Supply Chain
elective_modules.description: Learn how supply chain strategy can be used to create genuine competitive advantage for an organisation.

elective_modules.name: Project and Change Management
elective_modules.description: Build practical skills in leading projects and managing organisational change.

elective_modules.name: Operations Management
elective_modules.description: Understand the principles of operations management and their application to procurement and supply.

elective_modules.name: Logistics Management
elective_modules.description: Develop expertise in logistics strategy, planning and execution.

elective_modules.name: Advanced Negotiation
elective_modules.description: Build advanced negotiation skills for complex, high-value commercial scenarios.

hero.headline: CIPS Level 6 Professional Diploma in Procurement and Supply
hero.sub_headline: The final step on your journey to MCIPS: strategic leadership, global commercial strategy, and the capability to shape procurement direction at the highest level.
key_facts: Ofqual Regulated - equivalent to Honours-level degree

course_overview.headline: About This Qualification
course_overview.body:
The CIPS Level 6 Professional Diploma in Procurement and Supply is the final qualification on the direct pathway to MCIPS Chartered status. It's built for senior professionals ready to lead at a strategic level - evaluating global commercial strategy, driving ethical leadership, and shaping the future direction of procurement and supply within their organisation.

Once you've completed Level 6 (alongside the required relevant experience), you're ready to apply for MCIPS Chartered status - CIPS's mark of full professional recognition.

who_its_for.entry_requirements: Completion of the CIPS Level 5 Advanced Diploma (or an accepted exemption). This is not an entry-level qualification.

elective_modules.name: Innovation in Procurement and Supply
elective_modules.description: Explore how innovation can be embedded into procurement and supply practice to drive organisational value.

elective_modules.name: Supply Network Design
elective_modules.description: Develop strategic capability in designing and optimising supply networks.
